title: Heterotic Mirror Symmetry for Bundled Calabi–Yau Manifolds
exact_target: Formulate and construct heterotic mirror pairs with vector bundles, including the proposed Fourier--Mukai description for elliptic K3 surfaces.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000361 (OWR-1114-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Heterotic Strings, Derived Categories, and Stacks (2005), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2005/53, pp. 3019--3060; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 9--10, printed pages 3027--3028.
string compactifications on stacks; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: The report asks for a general meaningful formulation as well as a procedure. It does not define a unique universal mirror functor or state that all bundles meet the string anomaly and stability conditions. The elliptic-K3 proposal is a particular included question.
